owned_rows.summary: Parses PRD controls, warns on defaults, and transactionally applies the derived state fields.
Characterizes PRD frontmatter parsing, defaults, enum and integer validation, malformed blocks, optional flags, and warnings.
Reads the task snapshot and returns a distinct failure when its count exceeds the loop ceiling.
A real task list longer than the ceiling is over-limit; missing or non-list tasks count as zero.
Characterizes the fifteen-task plan ceiling, override semantics, tolerant task counting, no mutation, CLI exposure, and missing-state failure.
deferred/{batch}-deferred.json append ledger used for stalls and decisions carried to batch end.
Independent sidecar advisory lock serializing deferred-ledger updates.
Verified JSON handoff from supervisor death/stall decision to the next workflow session.
Runs the durable stall saga for a PRD, including hold move, defer record, and reset.
Consumes or reconciles a park request and applies the systemic-park breaker.
Appends one JSON object to a batch deferred ledger with PRD attribution.
Appends a computed completed-PRD batch summary and resets consecutive parks.
Malformed or conflicting stall intent, mismatched PRD, or missing batch identity refuses before filesystem effects.
Hold creation/move, deferred append, or state transaction failure returns its distinct code while durable intent preserves retryability.
Verified move plus deduplicated defer record commits PRD reset, park-breaker rule, and intent deletion atomically.
No marker returns no-work unless a pending stall intent exists, which is reconciled first.
Malformed marker or PRD no longer in wip is deleted and returns ignored without moving another PRD.
The first consecutive wrapper-death park moves and resets the PRD, increments the breaker, and continues.
The second consecutive wrapper-death park also writes paused/systemic_park state and returns the halt code.
Test-only durable-saga interruption selector for named stall/park boundaries.
Per-batch durable deferred object containing batch_id and ordered items.
Caller record copied with prd attribution; op_id deduplicates retrying stall appends.
JSON handoff carrying prd and reason for the next session's durable park saga.
Characterizes subprocess dispatch, stall and park outcomes, reset and restore behavior, deferred records, diagnostics, and exit codes.
Characterizes walk-up default path resolution and explicit state or PRD-directory override precedence for stall and park.
Characterizes selection, phase transitions, resume targets, convergence, rework, drain, frontmatter application, walk-up paths, and future-state refusal.
Characterizes deferred-log append and deduplication plus the authoritative per-PRD reset field set and preservation rules.
Characterizes record, stall, and park boundary failures, corrupt shapes, invalid identifiers, filesystem errors, idempotent retry, and no-effect guarantees.
Pins that importing records through the CLI does not leak the scripts directory into the interpreter search path.
Characterizes park-marker reconciliation, crash recovery, conflicting stall intents, atomic reset and counter updates, and systemic second-park halt.
Characterizes durable stall intent, verified PRD moves, deferred append, reset composition, crash-point retries, conflicts, and site-specific park-counter handling.
Pins phase-two stall effects: PRD moves to hold, stall clearing, per-PRD reset, batch preservation, hold creation, and sequence retention.
Characterizes atomic completed-PRD record creation, task and cycle defaults, escalated and autonomous decision counts, blank-row filtering, PRD matching, reset, and sibling preservation.
Drained state archived as reports/{batch}-state-final.json before post-drain actions.
Durable batch Markdown report with replaceable per-PRD sections, stalled records, and final summary.
Durable review-directory Markdown projection of autonomous, deferred, and doubt decision arrays.
Current sanitized rendering inputs, including legacy and rich nested state shapes.
Current archived batch-state contract with completed-PRD and decision history.
Expected audit, metrics, report-section, report-summary, and status rendering contracts.
Renders the per-PRD decision audit from state arrays into the repository review directory.
Creates or updates batch report PRD, stalled, or summary sections from state and metrics.
Prints a deterministic Markdown summary of loop metrics rows.
Characterizes status, audit, metrics, and report rendering against goldens, tolerant missing data, batch scoping, decision tables, flags, and rerender effects.
Pins omission of wholly blank autonomous-decision rows while retaining zero and any populated renderable cell.
Characterizes exact Markdown section replacement, duplicate collapse, heading boundaries, unrelated-section preservation, and report idempotence.
Characterizes batch-summary binding of completed-PRD counts and cycle and decision totals: nonzero retained values, legitimate empty zeros, and unknown sums for legacy or mixed records.
Returns the authoritative resume target after schema-version preflight.
Characterizes resume-target priority across stall intent, park marker, pause and stall state, phase routing, legacy phases, and systemic park halt without mutation.
backlog, wip, hold, and done files provide selection and verified-move lifecycle evidence.
Selects deterministically from wip then backlog while excluding hold, returning JSON even when drained.
Characterizes five-digit PRD sequence parsing, deterministic ordering, Markdown filtering, work-in-progress priority, backlog fallback, drain, and hold exclusion.
Atomically clears per-PRD state and restores build counters and phase markers.
Applies one named workflow outcome from the current phase as an atomic transition.
Characterizes the pure transition table for phase advancement, rework, convergence, per-PRD reset, drain, marker idempotence, and unknown input refusal.
Pins documentation coverage for every registered CLI subcommand.
